notes.title: Build Update 20250724
notes.content:
[p]Hey Pioneers!  [/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a new patch packed with improvements, bug fixes, and fresh features based on your feedback. Thank you all for testing, reporting, and helping us shape Brave New Wonders! Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]New Tech Tree Design: Major visual upgrade with new animations and bug fixes![/p][/*][*][p]Added "Stop Production" button on manufacturers[/p][/*][*][p]Added Minimap when selecting destinations for automatons[/p][/*][*][p]Added enemy drone loot drops[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced new pinned resource design[/p][/*][*][p]New destination arrow for better visual clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Energy production and consumption rebalanced[/p][/*][*][p]Early game recipes rebalanced[/p][/*][*][p]Added a texture quality settings in graphics menu(more graphics settings to come!)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the unresponsive Blueprint button[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Submit Feedback UI layout[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed frame rate drops in southern areas[/p][/*][*][p]And more![/p][/*][/list][p]
Thanks again for all your support and bug reports. Keep the feedback coming—we're building this game together! 🛠️
👉 Don’t forget to submit feedback in-game and wishlist Brave New Wonders if you haven’t already!


Cheers,
Sala @ City From Naught[/p]

notes.title: Build Update 20250707
notes.content: [p]Thanks for all your support and feedback — we’ve been hard at work! Here’s what’s new in this build:[/p][p][b]✨ Visual & UI Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated overall UI for a cleaner and more immersive experience[/p][/*][*][p]Brand new character animations[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned resource icons for better readability[/p][/*][*][p]New tutorial UI with more visual guides and image-based instructions[/p][/*][*][p]Added a mini map with clearer indicators, plus a new big map for better navigation[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Artificer[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🤖 Gameplay & Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Automaton settings now support [b]pin/unpin[/b] for easier management[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]construction site tutorial[/b] to guide you through building[/p][/*][*][p]Exit-to-main-menu now includes a confirmation popup to prevent accidental loss[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]pickup shortcuts[/b] for smoother resource collection[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🐞 Bug Fixes & Performance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed frame rate drops in certain scenes[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed save system bugs for more reliable saves and loads[/p][/*][*][p]Improved enemy drone animations for better clarity and impact[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned several factory components for better visual feedback and function[/p][/*][*][p]And many more[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll continue improving based on your feedback. Keep sharing your thoughts — and thank you for being part of this journey![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Sala @ City From Naught[/p]

notes.title: Build Update 20250626
notes.content:
[p]Thank you all for your valuable feedback — it means a lot to us! We usually take about a week to gather feedback, create tickets, fix bugs, build and test new updates. So hang tight — we're working hard to keep improving the game and deliver new builds regularly! [/p][list][*][p] Added language selection option[/p][/*][*][p] Added Chinese localization[/p][/*][*][p] Added mouse icon in control tutorial[/p][/*][*][p] Updated tech tree visuals for better clarity[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue with map blocking selection[/p][/*][*][p] Updated Discord link in-game[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed automaton-related crashes[/p][/*][*][p] Improved font fallback handling[/p][/*][*][p] Made supply drop more noticeable[/p][/*][*][p] Updated hologram visuals[/p][/*][*][p] Increased backpack capacity[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed car shaking issue
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Build Update 20250619
notes.content: [p]🚀 [b]Brave New Wonders - Quality of Life & Content Update[/b] 🌞 2025/6/19[/p][p]Here’s what’s new in our latest update:[/p][list][*][p]🧠 [b]Tech Tree Redesign[/b] – A cleaner, more intuitive progression system.[/p][/*][*][p]🎒 [b]Bigger Backpack[/b] – Starting inventory increased from 10 to 20 slots.[/p][/*][*][p]🔧 [b]Updated Toolbar[/b] – Slimmer design for better visibility during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]🪂 [b]Improved Supply Drops[/b] – Now much easier to spot![/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Crash Fixes[/b] – Resolved an issue related to space bar usage.[/p][/*][*][p]🔒 [b]Blueprint Mode Hidden Early On[/b] – To avoid overwhelming new players.[/p][/*][*][p]🤖 [b]New Tutorial[/b] – Learn how to assign tasks to your automatons.[/p][/*][*][p]⚡ [b]Dynamic Building Animations[/b] – Now react to power levels in real time.[/p][/*][*][p]❌ [b]Close Buttons Added[/b] – All windows now have a proper exit icon.[/p][/*][*][p]🔁 [b]View Switch Shortcut[/b] – Changed to Tab for quicker access.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing and stay tuned for more updates! 🏗️🌍[/p]
